_comment: Tier-2 for the SPARTA surface dependency chain, three claims in one deck. Nine wrong orderings are fed to the installed binary and each one aborts NON-ZERO with the message the knowledge quotes, verbatim including the (file:line) suffix: read_surf.cpp:73, surf.cpp:227, surf.cpp:230, surf.cpp:260, surf.cpp:343 twice, domain.cpp:100 and domain.cpp:253 twice. The partial-binding case is the load-bearing one — binding only 'group left surf id <= 25' of a 50-element data.circle reports 'ERROR: 25 surface elements not assigned to a collision model', so N is the count STILL UNBOUND, exactly as claimed, not the total. Four forms the entries call correct all run: correct_order, surf_collide declared before read_surf, both groups bound, and an 's' face bound with bound_modify. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). Skips when no binary is present, and the skip prints no expected key, so the runner records a failure rather than a pass.
